main_text.l: Iussi nopotes Abramidûm, polos Atque alta scandam nubila, par Deo Fiam supremo, par supremis Imperium imperiis tenebo. Sed vana ridens somnia cœlitus Qui cuncta nutu terrifico domat Intrare te nigras Auerni Nunc iubet attonitum cauernas. Quisquis subactos imperij videt Fasces superbi: Quisquis honoribus Te cernit exutus iacentem Sic subito perijsse casu. Tales recludit pectore territo Voces. Quid? heu! heu! sic modo corruit Quem regna, quem tellure tota Luctiferum timuere gentes? Qui rura charis vbera frugibus Pinguesque campos milite sauiens Victore vastauit? patentem Quiq;[?] ferox populatus orbem Ceu tesqua versis reddidit urbibus Inhospitalem? Qui laribus procul Gentes paternas, & perenni Carcere continuit reuinctas? Quos ante lethi dura necessitas Reges peremit nunc memorabilis Moles sepulchri, nunc per orbem Structa domi monumenta clarant.

page.notes: The "Quiq" line has a mark above and beside the q that I could not read with certainty; it is probably the abbreviation for quique, marked [?]. The "Sed" at lower right is a catchword and is not part of the text. Faint printed text at the right edge is show-through from the reverse side and is left out. The tilde over the u in "Abramidûm" is read as printed.
